scripts.dev: concurrently -n merchant,customer -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:merchant" "npm run dev:customer"
scripts.build: npm run build:merchant && npm run build:customer
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck -w @bookglow/database-contracts && npm run typecheck -w @bookglow/supabase && npm run typecheck -w @bookglow/shared-types
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:packages && npm --prefix apps/merchant-portal run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/customer-site run typecheck
scripts.release:build: npm run release:check && npm run build
